patch.description:
Approve expert.
Validation: WHERE id=expert_id AND role_type="expert" → 404 if not found
profile_status must be pending_review or processing → 400 otherwise

Decline expert with notes popup.
Validation: WHERE id=expert_id AND role_type="expert" → 404 if not found
profile_status must NOT be declined → 400 if already declined

get.description:

Add expertise tag.
Validation: Expert must exist with role_type="expert" → 404

Remove expertise tag.
